content: HECW2, also known as HECT, C2, and WW domain-containing E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 2, is a protein encoded by the HECW2 gene in humans. Model organisms have been utilized to investigate the function of the HECW2 protein. A conditional knockout mouse line, named Hecw2tm1a(EUCOMM)Wtsi, was developed at the Wellcome Trust Sanger Institute. Both male and female mice from this line underwent a standardized phenotypic screening process to assess the effects of HECW2 gene deletion. Additional analyses included detailed immunological phenotyping to further characterize the impact of the gene's absence. Clinically, mutations in the HECW2 gene have been linked to epilepsy and intellectual disability. These mutations typically affect a single copy of the HECW2 gene and are thought to alter the normal function of the HECW2 protein.
